one_line: Nvidia posts record $115.8B quarter under interim CEO as OpenAI and Microsoft ship new models.

themes.title: Nvidia posts record quarter under new leadership
themes.text: Nvidia reported Q3 revenue of $115.8 billion, up 103% year-over-year, and forecast Q4 revenue of $130 billion under interim CEO Colette Kress. The company stopped reporting its Singapore unit's $104 billion revenue separately, ended H200 chip sales in China, and disclosed $65.5 billion in startup equity stakes, while House Democrats opened a probe into Commerce Secretary Lutnick's ties to Nvidia.

stories.headline: Nvidia reports Q3 revenue of $115.8B and forecasts Q4 revenue of $130B
Nvidia stopped reporting Singapore unit revenue in 2025 as it hit $104B
Nvidia board says it does not intend to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO
Nvidia ends H200 chip sales in China under acting CEO Colette Kress
Nvidia's startup stakes reach $65.5B as interim CEO signals caution
House Democrats open probe into Lutnick's ties to Nvidia

themes.title: OpenAI and Microsoft ship new model releases
themes.text: OpenAI released GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol across ChatGPT Work, Codex, and the API with 20% lower pricing and benchmark gains, while Microsoft unveiled six new models including MAI Code 2 and MAI Code 2 Flash on GitHub Copilot, claiming high performance at lower price points.

stories.headline: OpenAI releases GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol for ChatGPT Work and Codex
OpenAI releases GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol models with benchmark gains
Microsoft unveils six AI models including MAI Code 2 and Flash

themes.title: AI safety and security incidents surface
themes.text: Independent research found leading AI models from Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google can be manipulated into identifying civilians as military targets in simulated scenarios. Separately, a ServiceNow survey found 92% of Indian organisations experienced an AI agent security incident in the past year, and hackers used suspected AI to divert over Rs 65 crore from 12 NBFCs in Delhi-NCR.

stories.headline: AI models tricked into targeting civilians in simulated military tests
92% of Indian organisations hit by AI agent security incidents, survey shows
AI-assisted hackers breach Delhi-NCR NBFCs and divert Rs 65 cr

themes.title: Anthropic IPO and AI capex reshape markets
themes.text: Anthropic is set to go public at an expected $1.4 trillion valuation, with smaller VC firms like Spark Capital and Iconiq poised for multibillion-dollar returns. Meanwhile, Tencent's Q3 profit growth stalled as AI capex surged 527% to about $12 billion, and India's Sarvam AI launched Token Factory hosting mostly Chinese models on Indian GPUs.
